description: The customised 2011 National Household Survey table describes housing suitability, dwelling condition and persons per room, cross-classified by Aboriginal identity, registered or treaty Indian status, residence and age. It covers Alberta and the Northern Alberta Development Council region. These are direct observations of dwelling condition and occupancy. The descriptor identifies one IVT table and links a Beyond 20/20 viewer installer and guide. The viewer is a dependency, not a second dataset. Exact condition categories and unit-level geography are not stated. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the source title, description and original Alberta identifiers. The record labels the material Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs, current file access and numerical contents are unverified. No linked document, workbook, archive, installer or data body was fetched. Specific simulation uses remain unstated unless described above.
